reply_text:
The ticket is #8841, and I've replied to Pree's message in a thread in #central-random.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is a member of #central-random, so she can see that message herself.

He didn't name the customer. He called it "Tobias's dealer account" in the Plains. That's Marrow Fieldworks, the dealer network he has owned since January 2026, so I linked the two in my reply.

In the same reply I told her not to mix it up with MFW-218. That's an older ticket from April about door 4 and door 6 being reassigned at the west receiving entrance, recorded in a CRM note on the account.
